name: Thousand Island
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small amounts, but check ingredients for high FODMAP additions like onion powder or garlic.
preparationTips: Read labels carefully - some brands contain onion or garlic powder
Make homemade version with mayonnaise, ketchup, and pickle relish for better control
Store opened bottles in refrigerator and use within recommended timeframe
Start with smaller amounts to test individual tolerance
nutritionalHighlights: Contains vitamin E from mayonnaise base
Provides small amounts of lycopene from tomato ingredients
Source of healthy fats when made with quality oils
